candidate: Directed Cayley non-isomorphism and abelian generation dichotomy
relationship: I have approval from a responsible author or maintainer
notes: The selected results concern directed Cayley graphs: CayleyArc S x y means y=x+s for an increment s in S. The abelian equivalence retains all hypotheses: h+h=0, h nonzero, 3d=0 or 3d=h, a,d,h generate the ambient abelian group, and 2d is nonzero. The reflected supports are {a,a+d,a+d+h} and {a,a-d,a-d+h}; they are isomorphic exactly when a,h do not generate the group. Separately, for every positive natural r, the two displayed three-increment digraphs on ZMod (12*r) are non-isomorphic. The quantifier ranges over arbitrary vertex equivalences, without assuming affineness. No undirected-graph or spectral claim is selected. These adapt prior public formalizations, with no claim of mathematical novelty or independent human review. scope_fr: Sous les hypothèses de torsion, de non-dégénérescence et de génération affichées, les supports réfléchis définissent des graphes orientés isomorphes si et seulement si a et h ne génèrent pas le groupe ambiant.
Pour tout entier r strictement positif, les deux graphes orientés explicites sur Z/(12r)Z ne sont pas isomorphes, même en autorisant toute bijection des sommets.
